fields.value: Replication Data for: Polarity and anti-distortive polarons in WO3 through epitaxial shear strain

dsDescriptionValue.value:
This dataset contains the raw data needed to reproduce the figures in the article "Polarity and anti-distortive polarons in WO3 through epitaxial shear strain". The data are presented in
1) Plain text format (.xyz, .xy, .csv extensions)
2) ISO 28600:2011-compliant open-source SPM data files (.spm extension, can be opened in Gwyddion software)
2) Image format for STEM data, temperature-dependent RSM plots (.png extension)
3) Bruker sfrm format for SCXRD data (.sfrm extension, can be imported into CrysAlisPro software). The SCXRD data is accompanied by a .par file containing the peak table with peaks for the four indexed triclinic domains and the substrate (can be imported into CrysAlisPro software).
